unit: USD per million tokens, Standard short context
caveat: Caller-supplied rate snapshot verified from official sources on this date. API-equivalent modeling assumes Standard pricing and <=272K tokens per request; Codex events report aggregate token usage but do not establish every request's context length, cache-write charges, service tier or actual subscription billing.
